purpose: Screenshot-only road styling review; no production style has been selected or changed.
source: Bundled real Capitol Hill OpenStreetMap geometry, not a synthetic street layout.
composition: All panels are uniformly reduced to logical screen size; no image-specific retouching.

controls.width: Multiplier of existing zoom/class-dependent mask stroke width.
controls.dilation: Multiplier of nearby-dot sampling distance, retaining the existing class gate.
controls.contrast: Street color blended toward the background, independently of dot size.
controls.glow: Multiplier of palette neon glow. Seattle has none; tested separately with Tokyo dark.

A.name: Crisp and thinner
A.assessment: Shortlisted alternate: crisp network, especially in light mode; more assertive than C.

B.name: Quieter, not thinner
B.assessment: Diagnostic: reduces glare but remains broad, particularly washed-out in light mode.

C.name: Balanced
C.assessment: Balanced on Seattle light/dark; close-zoom connections and exploration labels remain visible. Tokyo loses some neon energy, motivating F. Not an approved production profile.

D.name: Full correction, no dilation
D.assessment: Rejected in this sample: fragile streets and conspicuous parallel motorway stripes.

E.name: Refined after first review
E.assessment: Second-round test: more delicate than C, without a clear aesthetic gain; C better sustains the network.

F.name: Balanced, preserving theme glow
F.assessment: Recommended direction, narrowly ahead of A: retains more neon presence than C without baseline bulk. Identical to C in Seattle, whose palette has no glow; separately rendered in Tokyo dark. Motorway mass and striping remain.

limitations: No live tile URL was available. Fixture coverage supports these z15–17 views, not citywide z11–14 comparisons, other cities, or rural scenes.
The screenshotter rejects fixture views outside its geographic bounds rather than presenting missing streets as successful decluttering.
The fixture geometry is OSM-derived but does not reproduce the live server's complete cartographic zoom generalization.
The motorway slab remains visually dominant; these experiments do not establish a fix for stacked parallel carriageways.
These are static CanvasKit captures, not device-GPU, pinch/LOD-transition, or frame-rate tests.
Exploration uses the existing deterministic demo walk. Actual friends and live trails are not present.
No production width-unit conversion, class-visibility thresholds, or zoom-dependent contrast/dilation policy has been changed.

validation.check: just check: 198 suites, 2051 tests passed; typecheck, lint, format and release-telemetry checks passed.
validation.neutralControls: All four controls explicitly set to 1 produced a byte-identical PNG to baseline.
validation.review: Built-in code review unavailable; separate read-only code reviewer found no significant issues.
